description: Find Facebook business pages by keyword and city, or enrich page URLs and IDs with public contact details. Keyword search uses Facebook's own page search and needs a Facebook session; page enrichment runs without cookies.

categoryFilter.description: Keep pages whose enriched category contains any of these terms (case-insensitive). Filtering happens after enrichment.
categoryFilter.title: Category Filter

contactFilter.description: Keep only lead-ready pages that expose the selected contact field.
contactFilter.title: Contact Filter

cookies.description: Optional. Needed only for keyword discovery. c_user and xs are enough. Accepts a JSON array of cookie objects or a raw name=value; name2=value2 Cookie header. Page enrichment works without cookies.
cookies.sectionDescription: Cookies are used only for Facebook page search. They are never sent when enriching public page URLs.
cookies.title: Facebook Session Cookies

failOnEmpty.description: Fail the run when zero page rows are produced. Leave off to finish successfully with diagnostic rows explaining why nothing was found.
failOnEmpty.title: Fail When Empty

includeFailedPages.description: Emit diagnostic rows with errorCode, detailsError, and fieldsFound for pages that cannot be enriched. This prevents silent empty runs.
includeFailedPages.title: Include Failed Pages

includeReviews.description: Fetch the public reviews tab and include reviews when Facebook exposes them. Adds one request per page. Review coverage is partial.
includeReviews.title: Include Reviews

locations.description: City or region names added to the search query as a soft hint. Facebook does not expose a reliable city filter, so always verify the enriched address. Use strictLocation to drop rows whose address does not contain the location.
locations.title: Locations

maxItems.description: Maximum number of successful page rows. Failed rows do not consume this limit.
maxItems.title: Maximum Pages

minFollowers.description: Keep pages with at least this many followers. Pages with no follower count are dropped when this is above 0.
minFollowers.title: Minimum Followers

pageIds.description: Facebook numeric Page IDs, usernames, or page URLs. Numeric IDs are fetched through https://www.facebook.com/<id>.
pageIds.title: Page IDs or Usernames

proxyConfiguration.description: Used only for keyword discovery. Defaults to Apify residential proxy because Facebook search blocks datacenter IPs. Public page enrichment does not use it.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

searchTerms.description: Keywords for Facebook page discovery, for example Coffee Shop or Dentist. Each term is combined with each location as a text query. Facebook keyword search requires a cookie containing both c_user and xs.
searchTerms.title: Search Terms

startUrls.description: Direct Facebook page URLs to enrich, for example https://www.facebook.com/ozonecoffeeuk. Can be combined with pageIds and searchTerms.
startUrls.title: Facebook Page URLs

strictLocation.description: Drop pages whose enriched address does not contain the search location. This is a best-effort post-filter, not an exact city boundary.
strictLocation.title: Strict Location Post-Filter

verifiedOnly.description: Keep only pages whose public payload explicitly marks them as verified.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified Pages Only

title: Facebook Business Page Finder Input
